🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can simplify a ratio and write it in the form 1 : n

✓ I can share an amount in a ratio

✓ I can solve ratio problems with one part known

So nobody ever takes more than their fair share!

🍗 The nugget split

18 nuggets. Your mate takes 12 and gives you 6. "12 : 6. That's fair, right?"

Simplify 12 : 6. Is it fair?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Groups of 6

12 is 2 groups, 6 is 1 group

Step 2

Simplest form

2 : 1

2 : 1. He gets DOUBLE. Not fair! 🍗
